artworks.title: Zintilomo (Gentleman)
artworks.description: The image shows two people in full body view, standing and walking within a grassy area. The person in the front is holding a falcon on their gloved left hand. They have curly hair that extends to their ears and are wearing a hat, a tunic with detailed patterns, a belt, knee-high boots, a pendant, and thigh straps. The second person has short straight hair and is holding a leash attached to two dogs. In the foreground, two dogs are wearing collars and moving forward eagerly. The background consists mostly of grass, and the image border has a decorative pattern.

artworks.title: Chavalier (Knight)
artworks.description: The image shows two full-body figures. The larger figure stands facing slightly to the right, with his left hand on the hilt of a sword and his right hand by his side. He has curly hair, wears a hat, and has a serious expression. The smaller figure stands behind and to the left of the larger one, holding a stick or staff. Both figures wear tunics with intricate patterns. The scene is framed with a geometric border, and the background is a plain wall. At the bottom, there is text that reads "CHAVALIER VI."

artworks.title: Doxe (Doge)
artworks.description: The image shows a full-body drawing of a person standing in a slightly turned posture, with their left hand resting on the opposite sleeve. The individual has prominent facial features, including a slightly furrowed brow and a serious expression. They are wearing a distinctive hat that extends upwards in a pointed shape. Their clothing includes a long, flowing robe with detailed line work, fasteners on the sleeves. The background is simple, with a blank, unadorned background framed by a linear border with some ornamental markings.

artworks.title: Re (King)
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a throne. The individual is facing forward in a formal and upright position, with one hand on their hip and the other holding a scepter. The person has delicate facial features, a calm expression, long hair, and wears a crown and an ornate robe. The throne is simple in design, and there are vertical lines in the background.

artworks.title: Papa (Pope)
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a throne. The individual faces forward with a solemn expression, wearing a crown. Their robes drape over the chair, and they hold a scepter and a book. The background has a border with geometric patterns and the text "PAPA X" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Grammatica (Grammar)
artworks.description: The image features a full-length figure standing in a front-facing position. The person wears a long robe that extends to their feet, and a hood that covers their head but reveals their facial features. They have a solemn expression with furrowed brows, holding a scroll in their right hand and a cup in their left hand. The background is light with a decorative border displaying a diagonal striped pattern. Text below the figure reads "GRAMMATICA XXI."

artworks.title: Loica (Logic)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in a side profile, portrayed mid-step with one foot raised. The individual has curly hair, structured features, and is wearing a detailed dress with puffed sleeves. They are barefoot and holding a cloth in their raised hand. The background is a plain, textured area within a frame.

artworks.title: Geometria (Geometry)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman sitting on a cloud, reaching her right hand towards three shapes (a circle, a square, and a triangle) floating beside her. She has curly hair tied up, wears elegant robes, and appears serene. The background displays a landscape with hills, a river, and rocks. The scene is framed by a detailed border with the word "GEOMETRIA" and Roman numerals "XXXIIII" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Aritmetricha (Arithmetic)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with hands clasped in front of the waist. The person has soft facial features and is wearing a draped head covering and a long robe with pleats at the waist. The background has a decorative border and a plain floor.

artworks.title: Musicha (Music)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person playing a wind instrument while seated on a chair. The person has curly hair, closed eyes, and wears a sleeveless dress with a belted waist. They are surrounded by a swan and various musical instruments on the floor. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Poesia (Poetry)
artworks.description: The image depicts a person playing a recorder. The person has long, wavy hair and delicate facial features. They are dressed in an intricate robe and hold a recorder against their lips. One hand rests on a jug on their knee. A decorative vase sits beside them on a textured surface. Mountains are shown in the background, and a patterned border surrounds the image, with the text "POESIA XXVII" at the bottom.

artworks.title: Philosofia (Philosophy)
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. The person is depicted in profile with their head turned slightly to the left. They have long, flowing hair, and are wearing a garment that drapes down to their bare feet. One hand holds a spear, while the other hand rests on a shield with a creature's face. The background is plain, with a patterned border framing the figure.

artworks.title: Theologia (Theology)
artworks.description: The image shows an upper half of a person with a dual-profile face, wearing draped clothing resembling a toga or robe. The individual has two faces merging at the back of the head, one looking left and the other slightly more to the right. Both faces have similar features with prominent noses and lips. The hair is textured and styled in waves over the head. The figure's hands are clasped in front. The background features a framed border with diagonal lines and a semicircular pattern filled with stars below, with the text "THEOLOGIA XXV" written underneath.

artworks.title: Pilate Washing His Hands
artworks.description: The image displays several individuals from the waist up. In the center, a figure with long dark brown hair and facial hair wears a brown robe and a golden halo. To the right, another individual with long hair, a multi-colored hat, and a red and white outfit with blue leggings is shown washing his hands in a golden basin. Other individuals are also visible, one wearing a green robe and another in a red tunic and blue pants. The setting includes a grassy area and steps leading up. The background shows a blue sky over a pale, landscape-like area.

artworks.title: Christ Bearing the Cross
artworks.description: The image shows a figure carrying a large wooden cross. The individual is positioned bending slightly forward under the weight of the cross, which rests on his shoulder. His face is turned slightly to the left, with long brown hair and a beard, wearing a green crown on his head and a long brown robe. Other individuals in the background are dressed in robes of various colors, including red, blue, and brown, with some figures also visible in profile or three-quarter views. Two of them have golden halos around their heads. The background consists of a vibrant green ground beneath a blue and light brown sky.

artworks.title: Christ Nailed to the Cross
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene. The image depicts a figure on a cross with two other figures on either side. The central figure is depicted in a loincloth with a halo behind their head. On the left, another figure is holding a hammer or similar tool. The colors are bright and the outlines are distinct, with the background consisting of a grassy landscape and a blue sky with swirling clouds. The style is reminiscent of medieval woodcuts.

artworks.title: Raising the Cross
artworks.description: This is a painting of several figures surrounding a wooden cross. The figures are depicted actively moving the cross, which appears heavy and tilted. They are dressed in colorful garments, with one figure wearing a hat with feathers. The faces of the figures are expressive and bold. The scene is set against a partly clear, blue sky with greenery in the background. This painting resembles medieval woodcut illustrations and is in the style of Albrecht Dürer.

artworks.title: The Crucifixion
artworks.description: This is a painting of a crucifixion scene. The scene features a figure on a cross, with a crown of thorns and a cloth around the waist, set against a backdrop of blue skies and greenery. Surrounding the central figure are several other figures dressed in robes, depicted with halos. The figures are wearing garments of varying colors including red, blue, and green. The painting is in a medieval woodcut style with bold outlines and a somewhat flat perspective.

artworks.title: Madonna Overcome
artworks.description: The image shows six individuals standing in a landscape with green hills and a blue sky. The central figure, a woman with a sad expression, is supported by others. She wears a blue robe over a brown dress and has a halo above her head. The woman to her right comforts her, also with a halo. Three men on the left wear earthy tone robes, each with a halo. One man stands with clasped hands. The individual on the right has a white headdress partly covering their face, with a caring expression.

artworks.title: Descent from the Cross
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals engaged in a scene where a central figure with a crown of thorns is being lowered from a cross. The central figure, with long hair and a beard, is being supported by a man climbing down a ladder. Two other figures are also present, one in a red garment and a blue headscarf, and another cloaked in blue with a halo. The background includes a blue sky and trees.

artworks.title: The Entombment
artworks.description: The image shows a full body depiction of the burial of Jesus Christ. Jesus is being lowered into a tomb by several figures. He is lying in a slanted position with his head resting on the side of the tomb, eyes closed. He has a radiant halo, long, dark hair, and a body that displays wounds. A man in a long, yellow robe and a pointed hat is handling the fabric around Jesus. Four other figures surround them, each with distinct facial features. They are positioned closely, some with hands in a gesture of prayer or mourning. The backdrop features a green landscape and a blue sky with subtle horizontal streaks.

artworks.title: Descent into Limbo
artworks.description: This is a painting of a religious scene with a figure in a red robe, holding a staff, extending a hand towards a group of people through an arched doorway. A green creature with a raised hand is behind them, and a blue creature and broken barrier are at the figure's feet. The scene has expressive details and vivid colors, set against architectural elements and an earthly backdrop. The style is reminiscent of medieval religious paintings, possibly early Christian iconography.

artworks.title: The Resurrection
artworks.description: This is a painting of a figure standing in front of a tomb with soldiers around. The central figure is dressed in red robes, holding a staff with a flag, emerging from a rectangular stone-structured tomb. A soldier in a red helmet and golden-yellow attire is to the left, while another soldier in blue headgear and golden-yellow clothing is to the right. The sky is blue with streaks of white, and there is green foliage and grass in the background. The painting features bold colors and prominent outlines, reminiscent of medieval woodcut prints or early Renaissance art.

artworks.title: Ascension
artworks.description: The image shows the lower half of a person's body, with only the feet and the hem of a garment visible. Surrounding this central figure are several individuals whose faces and upper bodies are visible. These people are positioned in a semicircle, with many kneeling in an attitude of prayer or reverence. Their facial features are stylized, with simplified expressions and lines representing eyes, noses, and mouths. The figures have halos around their heads and most have hair with simple lined patterns. They are dressed in robes of varying colors and are situated on a green area. The background is plain and neutral.
